chunks: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: I was with my father in al-Hijr. While he was standing in prayer, a man came to him and sat beside him. When he finished, he greeted him, then said: I ask you about three things that none knows except you and one other man. He said: What are they?

He said: Inform me, what was the cause of the circumambulation (tawaf) of this House? So he said: When God Mighty and Majestic commanded the angels to prostrate before Adam (peace be upon him), they objected to Him.
They said: [2:30] Will You place therein one who makes mischief and sheds blood, while we glorify You with praise and sanctify You? God Blessed and Exalted said: I know what you do not know.

So He became angered at them. Then they beseeched Him for repentance, so He commanded them to circumambulate al-Durah — and it is the Bayt al-Ma'mur (the Oft-Frequented House) — and they remained circumambulating it for seven years and seeking forgiveness from God Mighty and Majestic for what they had said.

Then He turned to them with mercy after that and was pleased with them. This was the origin of the circumambulation. Then God made the Sacred House (Ka'ba) facing al-Durah as repentance for those among the Children of Adam who sin, and as purification for them. And he said: You have spoken the truth.

key_terms.التوبة: Tawbah — repentance; turning back to God after disobedience
key_terms.الحجر: Al-Hijr — the semicircular enclosure adjacent to the Ka'ba associated with Ishmael's grave (also called al-Hatim)
key_terms.الضراح: Al-Durah — the heavenly counterpart of the Ka'ba, identified here with the Bayt al-Ma'mur
key_terms.الطواف: Tawaf — the ritual circumambulation of the Ka'ba, one of the essential rites of Hajj and Umra
key_terms.الْبَيْتُ الْمَعْمُورُ: Bayt al-Ma'mur — the 'Oft-Frequented House', the celestial Ka'ba mentioned in the Quran (52:4), circumambulated by the angels

ai.seo_question: What is the origin and spiritual significance of the tawaf (circumambulation) of the Ka'ba according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrating a cosmological account of the origin of tawaf (circumambulation of the Ka'ba). The Imam explains that when the angels were commanded to prostrate before Adam and instead raised the famous objection quoted in Quran 2:30, God became angry with them. To seek forgiveness, the angels were instructed to circumambulate al-Durah (the Bayt al-Ma'mur, the heavenly Ka'ba) for seven years. The earthly Ka'ba was then established in alignment with the celestial house as a means of repentance and purification for the descendants of Adam. The context is a private audience in al-Hijr at the Ka'ba, where an unnamed man tests Imam al-Baqir (AS) with esoteric questions only known to the Imam.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr and Ibn Mahboub, altogether from Al Mufazzal Bin Salih, from Muhammad Bin Marwan who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> was with my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> at the (Black) Stone. So whilst he<sup>asws</sup> was standing Praying, a man came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he sat (near) him<sup>asws</sup>. So when he<sup>asws</sup> finished, he greeted him<sup>asws</sup>, then said, ‘I ask you<sup>asws</sup> about three things, none knows these except you<sup>asws</sup>, and another man’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What are these?’

He said, ‘Inform me, which thing was the cause of the circumambulation of the House (Kaaba)?’ So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, when Heazwj Commanded the Angels that they should Prostrate to Adamsaww they responded to Himazwj, so they said [2:30] Are You going to Make in it one as shall make mischief therein and shed the blood, and we Glorify with Your Praise and extol Your Holiness?
Allahazwj Blessed and High said: He said: I know what you are not knowing.

Thus, Heazwj was Angered upon them. Then, they pleaded Himazwj for the Forgiveness, so Heazwj Commanded them that (to attain it) they should be circumambulating by Al-Zurah, and it is the Bayt Al-Mamour (The Oft-Frequented House). And they remained circuambulating by it for seven years, seeking Forgiveness of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic, due to what they had said.

Then Heazwj Turned towards them (with Mercy) and was Pleased with them. So this was the origin of the circumambulation. Then Allahazwj Made the Sacred House facing Al-Zurah, as (a means of) repentance for the ones from the Children of Adamas who sin, and (as a means of) Purificatin for them’. So he said, ‘Youasws speak the truth’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn abu Nasr and ibn Mahbub all from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Muhammad ibn Marwan who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘My father and I were in al-Hijr. When he was standing for prayer, a man came to him and sat down. When he completed his prayer, the man turned to him (the Imam), offered him the greeting of peace and said, ‘I want to ask you three questions which no one except you and another person knows.’ He (the Imam) asked, ‘What are they?’

He said, ‘Tell me what the reason is for Tawaf around this House?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘When Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, commanded the angels to prostrate before Adam, they responded saying, “Will You appoint someone who will destroy it with bloodshed, while we speak of You as free from all defects due to Your praise and holiness?”
Allah, most Blessed, most High said, “I know what you do not know.”

He expressed anger at them. They asked Him to accept their repentance. He then commanded them to make Tawaf around al-Durrah which is al-Bayt al-Ma £ mur (the established house). They continued doing it for seven years and asked Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, for forgiveness because of what they had said.

He turned to them, accepted their repentance and expressed happiness with them. This was the origin of Tawaf. Allah thereafter made the sacred House parallel with al-Durrah so that those who commit sin of the children of Adam repent as a means to cleanse themselves.’ He (the man) said, ‘You have spoken the truth.’”
